'''Zeller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. She was a member of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] force [[Rusher's Brigade]], and in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], she accompanied the [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]], where they had been hired to [[Battle of Gazzari|fight]] for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]. After suffering heavy losses, the remnants of the brigade fled back to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]]&mdash;the [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']]&mdash;and Zeller was standing next to the ship's docking ramp when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and a group of refugees boarded the ship. The ''Diligence'' later traveled to the planet [[Syned]], and Zeller commanded [[Team Ripper]] during an [[Siege of Calimondretta|assault]] on the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Calimondretta]].
